newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Jochimsen says 1 pct growth reachable in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Jochimsen says 1 pct growth reachable in 1996.

text.p: Bundesbank board member Reimut Jochimsen said on Saturday he believed German growth could reach one percent in 1996.
"I believe one percent growth is reachable," he told journalists after addressing a seminar of young Europeans.
Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Friday that pan-German gross domestic product would grow around 0.75 percent this year and between two percent and 2.5 percent next year.
Rexrodt said the economy probably grew around one percent in the second quarter of 1996 from the same quarter a year ago.
Jochimsen said he believed growth had shown signs of picking up in the second quarter after a weak first quarter hit by the harsh winter and by a slump in the east German construction sector.
